practice: In a July 10, 2026 joint statement, the three main national blood organizations, AABB, America's Blood Centers and the American Red Cross (all non-government), gave donors one shared list of where to find a local site and book an appointment, each with a website and phone number, instead of pointing only to their own services.

operators.value: Non-government blood organizations in the examples found. The American Red Cross, a nonprofit, says it supplies about 40% of the nation's blood, and America's Blood Centers (an association of community blood centers) says there are 59 community blood centers in America.

sources.name: American Red Cross (nonprofit): American Red Cross Declares Second-Ever National Blood Supply Crisis (July 27, 2026)
America's Blood Centers (non-government): Current U.S. Blood Supply, Daily Inventory Report widget

find-site.value: Through the non-government blood organizations' locators: AABB's wheretodonateblood.org (+1.301.907.6977), America's Blood Centers' zip code search at americasblood.org (+1.202.393.5725), or the American Red Cross at RedCrossBlood.org, its Blood Donor App or 1-800-RED CROSS (1-800-733-2767).

sources.name: AABB, America's Blood Centers and American Red Cross (non-government): Joint Statement: Blood Donors Needed to Help Boost the Nation's Strained Blood Supply This Summer (July 10, 2026)

appointment.value: Appointments are encouraged. AABB, America's Blood Centers and the American Red Cross (all non-government) ask eligible donors to make and keep an appointment, and the Red Cross lists making an appointment, with a chosen donation type and time, as the first step before donating.
